int_name: W COURTLAND ST & OLD YORK RD

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a marked bike lane. While sidewalks and street lighting are present, the environment lacks pedestrian signals and features sidewalk obstructions from trash bins.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Trash cans and bins are placed on the sidewalk, narrowing the accessible path for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection has a vehicle traffic signal but no visible pedestrian-specific signals to indicate safe crossing times.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection on the utility pole.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve crossing safety and clarity.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and increase the visibility of pedestrians to drivers.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection featuring a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and continuous sidewalks. While basic infrastructure is present, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and visible curb ramps at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: A vehicle traffic light is present, but there are no visible pedestrian signal heads to provide dedicated crossing phases.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the traffic light pole

hazards.name: Lack of Visible Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The transition from the sidewalk to the crosswalk does not show clear ADA-compliant curb ramps, potentially hindering accessibility.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground corners where the sidewalk meets the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way and clearance intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and compliant slopes at the crosswalk landings.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. However, the environment lacks pedestrian signals, curb ramps, and daylighting, with parked cars potentially obstructing sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles immediately adjacent to the crosswalk limit the visibility between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street near the crosswalk markings.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of sloped curb transitions makes the crossing inaccessible for people using wheelchairs, strollers, or other mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners where the sidewalk meets the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between approaching vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure universal accessibility.
